entities.summary: Demetrio Giuliano Gianni Carta, known as Mino Carta, was an Italian-born Brazilian journalist, publisher and writer. Carta helped in the creation of Veja, IstoÉ and CartaCapital, three influential and iconic news magazines published in Brazil.
